comment: Bergman is the GOAT. Interesting class, very easy, and I learned a lot. Just participate, and you'll be set.
Professor Bill Bergman is a funny one and his fys was the easiest class I've ever taken, however, he expected a lot of participation and you needed to buy a 30 dollar reading material.
Bergman is funny and down to earth, cares about every student doing well and really doesn't expect much. FYS tests are so easy. Only bad thing is he can be biased about grading.

I LOVE Mr. B. Take advantage of him as a resource. Any class that offers him as a professor, I advise you to take. He is hilarious, available, and smart. He always finds ways to relate to his students. I took him for FYS and I'm sad I'm not a marketing major just because I love being in the environment he facilitates. Tests in FYS are SO easy.

I took MKT320 in the summer and I absolutely loved it! Professor Bergman's videos are always hilarious but explains the concepts very well. His 5 tests are also very manageable and don't have a time limit so you are free to submit them anytime before the deadline.

I love Professor Bergman! This was his first-semester teaching BUAD 205 and the class was always fun. He engages with his students and wants them to participate. He gives respected feedback and he's never rude like other bcomm professors. Classes were always laidback and I felt comfortable presenting around him. I plan on taking him for MKT320!
Highly subjective grader, you have to answer questions with the EXACT information he wants. Used a definition from the textbook to answer a test question and got points off.
Funny, experienced in the real world, and a good mentor for students. There's a reason he's one of the most popular marketing professors at Richmond
Definitely take any class you can with Bergman. He's a great mentor and friend.
Get on his good side early on by participating in class. Pick a good group for your project you will be spending A LOT of time together and this is a big portion of your grade. Exams are pretty easy
Bergman is awesome! I took his Professional Selling class and learned so much. Would definitely recommend. He makes learning fun. Best professor in Bschool, honestly.

Honestly the worst professor I've ever had at U of R. Grades are completely subjective and are based on playing favorites among the students. You could submit the exact same assignment as another student, and one could get an A and another could get a B-. Would not recommended ever unless you are friend with him.

Professor Bergman is loved by just about everyone! His digital marketing class presented lots of different topics in the world of digital marketing & included real time events. He is also an incredible mentor and provides very helpful, actionable advice.
Professor Bergman is one of the most engaging professors in the B-School. His class is fun, and you'll learn a surprising amount. Highly recommend this course. Very reasonable assignments.
Super fun class. Mostly based around a group project which was fun. Would take Bergman again!
Great class
Super fun class. Remember to participate. Big group project.  Awesome teacher!
Pick a good group for the project, because that's the main thing the class is based on. Study vocab for the tests and you'll get an A! Best mkting teacher. Would take again!
Such an awesome teacher. DEFINITELY take for MKT320, there isn't a better option. So funny, so nice!
AWESOME TEACHER. Definitely the only option for intro to marketing. You'll learn a lot but have fun still.
Best professor i've had in a long time
Makes you work for your grade. Makes you genuinely interested in marketing. Pick the right group for group projects...   (would take again)

Professor Bergman is really funny and engaging during class, but he doesn't teach much. He more just asks the class questions about the marketing world and what you notice, especially in ads. His tests are fill-in-the blankmultiple choice based on vocab from the textbook and short answer from what he says in class.

Professor Bergman made me so happy that I chose to be a marketing major. He's really funny and engaging. I always wanted to go to class. His tests are harder than you would expect but if you take notes on the discussion and readings, they're fine. There is also a final group project that takes up some time
Pretty cool guy, nice sense of humor
